claims.claim: The original optical inputs respected the registered coordinate exclusion.
claims.support: The original selector excluded several location fields and passed its initial checks.
claims.challenge: Four absolute centroid fields remained. One legitimate empty interphase shard also exposed an unhandled zero-row case.
claims.falsifier: Feature/schema or source-coverage replay differs from the declared policy.
claims.decision: Exclude the original centroid-containing fits. Retain the corrected reruns and the preserved empty-shard repair.
claims.next_discriminating_action: Reopen an engineering claim only with exact retained-value replay, complete checksummed coverage and independent reductions.
claims.reopening_criteria: Reopen an engineering claim only with exact retained-value replay, complete checksummed coverage and independent reductions.

claims.claim: The learned optical representation improves practical retrieval over simple methods.
claims.support: Real labels can outperform shuffled-label fits on the held-out genes.
claims.challenge: That comparison alone is insufficient; every seed must beat the strongest simple baseline by 0.02 with positive paired and joint intervals.
claims.falsifier: Any seed fails the fixed gain threshold or uncertainty bound against the strongest registered baseline.
claims.decision: Both arms fail the fixed practical gain gate. Keep original and expanded comparisons; no model or drug promotion. Equal-cap interphase learning outperforms its sampled mean, an exploratory finding that does not rescue full-data performance.
claims.next_discriminating_action: A new independently specified model comparison must pass strong baselines, controls and external-context checks before a gain claim.
claims.reopening_criteria: A new independently specified model comparison must pass strong baselines, controls and external-context checks before a gain claim.

claims.claim: BUB1B imaging coverage supplies a qualified functional model.
claims.support: Four interphase guides exceed 20 cells and agree with the public workbook. Complete mean profiles give BUB1B ranks 1/3/3/2 among 994 genes.
claims.challenge: Only one mitotic guide exceeds 20 cells; two are required. HeLa is transformed and p53-defective. Retrieval measures neither endogenous allele function nor joint drug response. The fourth guide ranks 836 with shared-scale medians, 9 with training-median scaling and 770-788 across neural seeds; other checkpoint targets are competing matches.
claims.falsifier: Independent restoration fails, relevant function is absent, or the required guide/context coverage is missing.
claims.decision: Retain missing mitotic retrieval; assess interphase agreement descriptively. HOLD functional and non-cancer transfer.
claims.next_discriminating_action: Qualify independent perturbation/restoration and useful function in the intended non-cancer model.
claims.reopening_criteria: Qualify independent perturbation/restoration and useful function in the intended non-cancer model.

claims.claim: The practical full-data comparison isolates representation quality.
claims.support: Methods use the same eligible genes and guide-excluded references.
claims.challenge: The model uses at most 128 cells per guide while full profiles use every cell. Published methods also motivate median aggregation.
claims.falsifier: A claimed advantage disappears with equal sampled cells or a stronger aggregation baseline.
claims.decision: Full-data means remain strongest. Equal-cap interphase means score 0.093093, below neural seeds, while full means score 0.234113. Preserve this distinction and exploratory timing; do not infer lack of all representation benefit from failed practical gain.
claims.next_discriminating_action: Separate information volume from representation using a locked equal-information comparison, followed by independent validation.
claims.reopening_criteria: Separate information volume from representation using a locked equal-information comparison, followed by independent validation.

claims.support: The source supplies eight acquisition plates and complete per-guide plate counts.
claims.challenge: The encoder is fitted on training-gene cells from all plates. Reference cohorts change by plate and sparse query coverage limits inference. A post-hoc plate-only and within-plate comparison was declared after favorable interphase BUB1B ranks were inspected; it does not replace independent batch confirmation. Cross-plate BUB1B full-mean ranks range from 1 to 520. The single-plate-only control has zero eligible genes everywhere; it is unavailable, not successful. Plate proportions alone do not reproduce the pooled BUB1B match, but do not rule out phenotype-specific batch effects.
claims.falsifier: A fixed held-out acquisition or sufficiently covered cross-plate query fails after batch-aware controls.
claims.decision: Reject the unseen-acquisition claim; report every plate and its denominator without comparison to the pooled cohort.
claims.next_discriminating_action: Hold out acquisition batches from fitting and qualify adequate independent-guide coverage before testing transfer.
claims.reopening_criteria: Hold out acquisition batches from fitting and qualify adequate independent-guide coverage before testing transfer.

claims.claim: A lower mitotic fraction or early favorable image establishes rescue.
claims.support: Complete exports allow observed mitotic/(mitotic+interphase) fractions by exact guide.
claims.challenge: Class labels depend on morphology; source normalization is within class. Entry, exit, cell loss and classification remain alternatives. Relative sensitivity can reverse at prolonged assessment.
claims.falsifier: Later daughter survival, sustained function or recovery deteriorates despite an early marker/fraction improvement.
claims.decision: HOLD rescue inference. Count all enrolled cells and tracking loss; preserve first-division fidelity and later fate as separate endpoints.
claims.next_discriminating_action: Demonstrate independently replicated useful output without unacceptable injury through a prespecified follow-up/recovery window.
claims.reopening_criteria: Demonstrate independently replicated useful output without unacceptable injury through a prespecified follow-up/recovery window.
